title: Baklava
description: A simplified version of the Middle Eastern classic — layers of filo pastry with crunchy mixed nuts (including pistachios) drenched in warm honey.
steps: Preheat the oven to 160°C/140°C fan. Grease a 25cm square baking tray.
Cut the filo into sheets exactly the size of the tray base. Cover with a damp tea towel to stop drying.
Chop the nuts into coarse chunks.
Assemble the baklava: start with 2 sheets of filo, scatter a quarter of the nuts, sprinkle with cold water. Repeat 3 more times, ending with a single sheet of filo.
Cut the baklava into diamonds with a sharp knife before baking. Bake for 50 minutes until the top is crisp and brown.
Heat the honey in a saucepan for 5–10 minutes until thin. Spoon over the baked baklava and return to oven for 10 minutes.
Cool completely in the dish before serving.
notes: Makes around 20 pieces. Per piece estimate. Pistachios are crucial. Use flavoured honey (cinnamon or lavender) for a more authentic taste.
